notes: Attackers now spread out in front of the gate instead of lining up behind each other.
A guard that is shot down is no longer lost at once: it has 15 seconds, counted out over it, for you or a medic to heal it. Stand next to it and it is back up in a few seconds.
KILN now floats closer to the commander in the early levels, and its glow is bigger so it reads the same size as in level 5.
Level 3: the camp wall no longer touches the rock piles behind it, so builders can always walk around the back.
Sela's arrival: the film ends as she steps out of her buggy. It stays parked at the camp's east entrance with its lights on, and she walks in from it.
